q1.explanationZh: 第三段说“舞者”会抓住新想法，或用新办法把旧想法组合起来，这就是有创造力。

evidence.quote: “Dancers” jump at new ideas or combine old ones in new ways.

q2.explanationZh: 第四段说研究对象是维基百科的读者。

evidence.quote: They focused on readers of the online encyclopedia Wikipedia.

q3.explanationZh: 第四段说团队看每个人读了多少不同的主题，以及这些主题联系有多紧，对应②和③。

evidence.quote: the team looked at how many different topics he or she read about and how closely those topics were connected

q4.explanationZh: 查了一个导演，再读他的电影，说明沿着一条清楚的线索找具体答案，这是“猎手”的特点。

evidence.quote: They follow a clear path to reach their goals.

q5.explanationZh: 文中说“猎手”更关心科学和技术，六个主题里化学最属于科技。

evidence.quote: “Hunters” cared more about science and technology.

q6.explanationZh: 文章先讲三种好奇风格，然后主要介绍Zurn团队的研究方法和结果，所以是报道一项研究。

evidence.quote: Zurn and his team went on to see how these curiosity styles play out in real life.
